title: Gerente De Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de PR e Marketing Tech da América Latina. Nós transformamos dados em decisões estratégicas. Com o uso de inteligência artificial e monitoramento de mídia de ponta, ajudamos marcas globais a entenderem sua reputação e o mercado em tempo real. Somos movidos por inovação, mas o que realmente nos sustenta são as pessoas. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, onde a tecnologia e a estratégia caminham juntas, seu lugar é aqui. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Gestão de Pessoas e Estrutura da Área: Liderar, desenvolver e estruturar o time financeiro, garantindo clareza de papéis, evolução técnica e um ambiente orientado a resultados e eficiência operacional. Faturamento (Billing): Assegurar a acuracidade e escalabilidade do faturamento, garantindo aderência ao modelo de negócio (SaaS/recorrente), com foco em eficiência operacional e mitigação de riscos. Contas a Receber (AR) e Gestão de Inadimplência: Definir estratégias e acompanhar indicadores de recebimento, atuando na redução de inadimplência, melhoria do ciclo de caixa e eficiência na conversão de receita em caixa. Contas a Pagar (AP) e Tesouraria: Gerir o fluxo de caixa de curto, médio e longo prazo, garantindo liquidez, otimização do capital de giro e alocação eficiente dos recursos financeiros. Compras e Gestão de Custos: Gerir processos de compras e contratos, buscando eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria contínua na relação com fornecedores. Controles Internos e Compliance: Estruturar e garantir a aderência a políticas, processos e controles financeiros, assegurando conformidade, governança e mitigação de riscos. Análises Gerenciais e Interface com Diretoria: Consolidar e apresentar análises financeiras (DRE, fluxo de caixa, unit economics, indicadores de performance), apoiando a diretoria na tomada de decisão estratégica. Estruturação de Processos e Eficiência: Identificar oportunidades de melhoria, automação e ganho de escala nos processos financeiros, elevando o nível de maturidade da área. Requisitos e qualificações: Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência consolidada em gestão de áreas financeiras;
Experiência na liderança de equipes e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
Conhecimento sólido emTesouraria, Contas a Pagar/Receber, Faturamento e Planejamento Financeiro;
Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver: Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência em empresas SaaS ou modelos de receita recorrente;
Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;
Experiência com estruturação de processos, automações e melhoria contínua;
Conhecimento em indicadores financeiros de SaaS (MRR, churn, LTV, CAC, NRR, etc.);
Experiência em interação com investidores, auditorias ou governança corporativa.

title: Inspetor(A) De Qualidade
description: Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Apoiar o fluxo de amostras e materiais dentro do laboratório. Manter o ambiente limpo e em conformidade com os procedimentos internos. Conhecimento em Boas Práticas de Laboratório(BPL) e em análises físicas/Químicas. Excel intermediário Experiência na área. Disponibilidade para atuar em regime de turno e escala. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência. Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned. fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;
and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS. Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling and analytical insights. Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description: About You This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly. You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly, and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments. Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments. Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts. Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage. Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations, including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices. Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends. Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines. Solid reliability engineering experience, including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety. Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling. Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation. Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents. Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform, including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation. Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services, ensuring high availability and operational resilience. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation. Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments. Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability. Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews. Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation. Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements. Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation. Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures. Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders. Qualifications 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments. Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts. IaC background with Terraform, including environment separation and state management at scale. Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data. You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have… 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus. What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness package Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

Daqui para frente, nossa linha de negócios continuará a entregar um crescimento sustentável e lucrativo de dois dígitos Procuramos talentos que partilhem a nossa ambição, que queiram representar, desafiem-nos e a si próprios a seguir em frente todos os dias. Procuramos profissionais que vibram conosco e que partilham os nossos valores: paixão pelos clientes, respeito, imaginação, simplicidade e espírito empreendedor Na Edenred, acreditamos que grandes conexões são uma força imparável. Nós os canalizamos para fortalecer negócios e fomentar soluções inclusivas. Criamos ecossistemas locais que criam mais riqueza. E mais saúde. Não só para as pessoas, mas também para o nosso meio ambiente. Melhores laços podem melhorar a vida. Damos a eles um propósito: promover o progresso. Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão são mais do que adesivos em nossas paredes, são pilares essenciais na gestão de pessoas e um compromisso com nossa sociedade. Portanto, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, independente de deficiência, raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra diversidade. Estamos plenamente convencidos de que uma equipe diversificada traz diferentes perspectivas, maior propriedade para resolver desafios e maior capacidade de inovação! Para todos que procuram esse tipo de VIBE em sua vida profissional, somos o melhor lugar para você! Missão do cargo Responsável por prospectar novos clientes (empresas), criar e alimentar pipeline de oportunidades e conduzir o processo de venda desde a abordagem inicial até o fechamento, com foco em bater metas comerciais. Responsabilidades: Prospecção ativa de clientes (cadastros frios, mapeamento de mercado, cold calls, LinkedIn, networking). Identificação de leads qualificados seguindo critérios de perfil ideal (segmento, porte, potencial). Realização de reuniões presenciais e virtuais com decisores para apresentar soluções da Ticket Log. Elaboração e negociação de propostas comerciais conforme diretrizes de pricing. Gestão do funil de vendas (pipeline) e uso de CRM para registro de todas as interações, status de oportunidades, follow-ups etc. Acompanhamento de todo o ciclo de venda: desde prospecção até a assinatura de contrato, entrega de documentação e ativação. Atuação colaborativa com equipes internas (marketing, operações, implementação) para garantir o cumprimento de expectativas do cliente. Monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e participação no planejamento de metas comerciais. Requisitos: Formação superior completa (Administração, Marketing, Engenharia, Relações Internacionais, Negócios ou áreas afins). Experiência prévia comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente com perfil “hunter” (prospecção ativa). Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas consultivas (ex: SPIN, Challenger, venda por valor). Habilidade de negociação e comunicação com stakeholders de diferentes níveis. Experiência com CRM (Salesforce, Pipedrive ou similares). Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e foco em resultados. Disponibilidade para deslocamentos, reuniões em campo e viagens constantes. Desejável conhecimento no segmento de frotas, mobilidade ou cartões corporativos. Inglês /intermediário será diferencial O que esperamos? Buscamos um profissional com perfil proativo, resiliente, orientado a resultados e com habilidade para trabalhar autonomamente. title: Coordenador De Order To Cash
description: Coordenador (a) de Order To Cash | Híbrido - São Paulo Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash). Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. O papel exige forte capacidade estratégica, mas também disposição para atuar no operacional quando necessário, sendo um verdadeiro backup do time. O desafio principal é gestão de pessoas, com foco em engajamento, crescimento e melhoria contínua dos processos. Principais Responsabilidades Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe, promovendo autonomia e direcionamento. Estruturar processos e implementar melhorias, incluindo planos de contingência. Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica, garantindo suporte operacional quando necessário. Importante conhecer todo processo operacional para gerenciar todo o ciclo Order to Cash, incluindo: Cadastro e registro de clientes (novos e recorrentes). Análise de crédito e definição de condições de pagamento. Faturamento e emissão de boletos (PIX, boleto bancário). Configuração de formas de pagamento no SAP. Conciliação bancária, baixa de recebíveis e títulos. Cálculo de PDD e análise da saúde do contas a receber. Apoiar atividades fiscais e contábeis relacionadas ao processo OTC. Propor e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores para gestão da área. Garantir comunicação eficaz com áreas internas (ex.: força de vendas) e clientes. Participar do fechamento contábil mensal. Requisitos Técnicos Excel avançado (mandatório). Experiência sólida em processos OTC, análise de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber e faturamento. Conhecimento em SAP (configuração e operação). Noções fiscais e contábeis para interação com áreas correlatas. Desejável: Power BI / Power Query (não prioritário). Inglês avançado. Formação superior completa (desejável pós-graduação). Competências Comportamentais Perfil autônomo, organizado e proativo. Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Comunicação clara e interpessoal positivo. Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução. Senso de urgência e habilidade para lidar com desafios. Diferenciais Experiência em ambientes com crescimento acelerado. Histórico de implementação de melhorias e desenvolvimento de equipes. Espanhol (desejável).

Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário. O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria: - Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.
- Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.
- Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).
- Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico. Você se identifica com este perfil? Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você. title: Ai & Innovation Experience Designer
description: AI & Innovation Experience Designer About the Role We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform. You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments. This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions. What You’ll Do Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys. Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools. Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle. Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership. Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences. Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision. Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments Preferred Qualifications Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys exploring the intersection of AI, commerce, and product innovation. If you’re excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we’d love to connect.

description: ABOUT CONTENTJET ContentJet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals. Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, OpenClaw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery. THE MISSION: REPLACE MANUAL WORK WITH AI AGENTS ContentJet is on a mission to become a fully AI-native agency. That means every workflow that currently requires a human clicking, copying, pasting, searching, emailing, or following up manually should be handled by an AI agent instead. We’re not looking for someone to build chatbots — we’re looking for someone who can systematically identify manual bottlenecks across our operations and replace them with autonomous agent systems that run 24/7 without human intervention. This includes: creator discovery and vetting, outreach campaign creation, brief reading and task assignment, content pipeline management, quality control, reporting, team notifications, client communication, and any repetitive operational task that currently eats human hours. THE ROLE You are the person who designs and builds complete AI agent systems from concept to production. You will own the architecture of multi-agent pipelines — defining agent roles, communication flows, tool integrations, and orchestration logic. You will work extensively with Claude Code CLI to build, test, and iterate on agent systems directly from the terminal — writing production-grade code, managing project structures, and leveraging Claude’s coding capabilities for rapid development. You will use Claude Cowork with MCP connectors to orchestrate complex workflows that read from Monday.Com, discover creators on TikTok/Modash, create Instantly campaigns, produce personalized documents, and coordinate across Slack channels — all without manual intervention. You will deploy agents via OpenClaw, our open-source AI agent gateway, to make them accessible across multiple platforms (Slack, Telegram, web) with full DM and group chat support, tool management, and multi-model routing. WHAT YOU WILL DO Systematically audit ContentJet’s operations to identify every manual task that can be replaced by an AI agent or automation Design and build multi-agent systems that fully replace manual workflows: creator sourcing, outreach, qualification, brief processing, campaign management, reporting, and team coordination Use Claude Code CLI as your primary development environment to Drive, Slack, and other platforms into seamless, zero-touch pipelines Deploy and configure agents via OpenClaw for multi-platform delivery (Slack, Telegram, web interfaces) with DM and group chat support Architect agent communication flows, decision trees, tool-use schemas, and escalation logic within the OpenClaw gateway Integrate agents with external tools via APIs and MCP connectors qualification, replacing manual phone screening Write production-grade Python agent code with proper error handling, logging, Slack integration (multi-channel), and monitoring Design prompt systems at the systems level — agent instructions, OpenClaw tool configurations, Claude Cowork task definitions, output parsing, and quality control Create CLAUDE.Md project files for agent codebases following enterprise-grade standards (security, design philosophy, code organization) Continuously look for new manual processes to automate — the goal is zero manual work for repetitive tasks MUST-HAVE SKILLS Python (production-level, not just scripting) — you write code that runs in production 24/7 Deep prompt engineering — system-level agent instructions, multi-step reasoning chains, tool-use orchestration, not simple chatbot prompts Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable building, testing, and shipping entire projects from the terminal using Claude as a coding partner Claude Cowork experience — ability to design and execute complex multi-step workflows using MCP connectors to orchestrate across platforms Experience with OpenClaw or similar AI agent gateways/orchestration frameworks for multi-platform agent deployment API integration experience (REST, webhooks, OAuth, API chaining) — you can wire any two systems together Experience building multi-agent or multi-step AI systems (CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, or custom builds) Strong understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how to connect Claude to external tools, databases, and services Understanding of agent design patterns: ReAct, tool-use, delegation, human-in-the-loop, autonomous decision-making Experience deploying agents across multiple platforms (Slack bots, Telegram bots, web chat) Strong English communication (written) — you’ll write agent specs, workflow documentation, and team guides NICE-TO-HAVE Familiarity with n8n (self-hosted) for workflow automation alongside agent systems Background in UGC, creator economy, influencer marketing, or content operations Experience with Monday.Com API, Modash, TikTok Creator Marketplace, or similar creator tools Experience configuring OpenClaw for multi-platform deployment with tool availability management and config troubleshooting French or Arabic language skills (for MENA market projects) WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Within 30 days: You’ve Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Ai Engineer
description: ABOUT CONTENTJET ContentJet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. We serve global clients across e-commerce, healthcare, and marketing verticals. Our core belief: every manual, repetitive task inside an agency can and should be replaced by an AI agent or automation. We use Claude Code CLI, Claude Cowork with MCP connectors, OpenClaw, n8n, VAPI, and custom multi-agent systems to eliminate manual work across every layer of our operations — from creator sourcing and outreach to content production, team coordination, and client delivery. THE MISSION: SHIELD OPERATIONS AND PERFECT THE AI DEPLOYMENTS ContentJet is undergoing a massive transformation to become a fully AI-native agency. While our AI Agent Architect and Automation Engineer build the complex infrastructure, we need a ruthless tester and operational bridge. Your mission is simple: ensure that no buggy agent, broken n8n workflow, or hallucinating AI ever reaches the CEO, our team, or our clients. You are the ultimate gatekeeper of quality and the translator between our agency operations and our engineering pod. THE ROLE You are the operational anchor of our AI transformation. You will not be writing the Python code or building the complex multi-agent architectures, but you must be technical enough to understand how they work, how they connect via APIs, and exactly how they break. You will audit our existing manual operations, write clear documentation detailing exactly what the AI needs to do, and hand those requirements to the engineering team. Once they build an agent (deployed via OpenClaw ) or an automation (via n8n ), your job is to try to break it. You will test every edge case, log every bug, and manage the feedback loop until the system is bulletproof and ready for the agency floor. WHAT YOU WILL DO Audit and Document: Deep-dive into our current agency operations, mapping out every manual click, copy-paste, and email to create clear requirements for the AI Architect. Relentless QA & Testing: Act as the\ "human-in-the-loop\" during the testing phase. You will vigorously test AI agents across Slack, Monday.Com, and web interfaces to find edge cases, hallucinations, and logic failures before deployment. Bug Reporting & Triage: Manage the development pipeline. When a VAPI voice agent fails a creator screening or an n8n webhook drops data, you write the detailed bug report for the engineering team. Prompt QA: Review the outputs of AI workflows (such as personalized creator briefs or automated emails) to ensure the tone, accuracy, and brand alignment are perfect. Protect the CEO: Fully own the testing and troubleshooting phase so the CEO can focus purely on running the agency, completely removed from software QA. Team Training: Once an AI agent or automation is finalized, you will write the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and train the ContentJet staff on how to use the new system. MUST-HAVE SKILLS Exceptional QA Experience: You have a proven track record of testing complex software, automations, or AI workflows and documenting bugs clearly. Technical Literacy: While you aren't writing production Python, you understand how APIs work, what webhooks are, and the basics of n8n and LLM prompt logic. You know why systems break. Hyper-Organization: You are a master of project management tools (Monday.Com, Jira, Linear) and can manage multiple concurrent AI deployments without dropping the ball. UGC / Agency Understanding: You understand how a creative agency functions—what a creator brief is, how outreach works, and the level of quality clients expect. Flawless English Communication: You will be writing detailed technical tickets, testing client-facing AI outputs, and writing internal training guides. NICE-TO-HAVE Previous experience working in an AI startup or working directly alongside AI Engineers. Hands-on experience with Monday.Com, n8n, or testing chatbot/agent outputs. Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows. Aligned with North American time zones (EST/PST). WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Within 30 days: You have fully audited our top 5 manual workflows, created a clear roadmap for the engineering pod, and established a formalized bug-reporting and testing system. Within 60 days: You are rigorously testing the first wave of deployed AI agents. You have successfully caught, documented, and helped resolve critical edge cases before they impacted agency staff. Within 90 days: You completely own the AI product lifecycle. The CEO is entirely removed from all QA and troubleshooting, and manual work across the agency is rapidly decreasing thanks to your smooth deployments.

title: Engenheiro De Software
description: About Us Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate. What You’ll Do: Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to: AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations. Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture. Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability. What we’re looking for 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript. Strong experience with Node.Js Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices. Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry. Strong hands-on experience with Nest.Js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services. Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications. Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management. Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.G., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies. Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling. Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher). What we offer Collaborative and innovative work environment Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule. Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
